//env: Turborepo warns about every variable set on the Vercel project that is not declared here. It is a CACHE-CORRECTNESS mechanism: an undeclared variable does not enter the task hash, so a build could be replayed from cache after that variable changed. Nothing here reads any of them at build time — `build` is `tsc` — but declaring them is what makes the hash honest and silences a warning that would otherwise train everybody to ignore build warnings.
//neonAliases: Neon's Vercel integration injects ~13 aliases of the same connection string. This project reads none of them — see .env.example — but they are on the project, so Turbo warns. Listed to silence it, NOT because anything consumes them. Delete a row here the day the matching variable is removed from Vercel.
